test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Some words in the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

The __rolling__ waves on the __beach__ were so __trainquil__ and __soothing__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2 i.e. 'trainquil'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word "trainquil" is misspelled.
 
• The correct spelling is "tranquil," which means calm or peaceful.
